correctness.rationale: The exact conditional-variance identity follows from the two-state Markov covariance (1-m²)rho^k; a bounded stopped-martingale argument proves the unsigned renewal variance rate, and dominated geometric summation handles the sign covariance. Stationarity bounds rho below by -(1-|m|)/(1+|m|), attained by an irreducible aperiodic matrix. The complete proof is in RESULT.md. Finite and tilted-kernel independent algebra checks passed in verify.py; numerical checks are not used as infinite proofs.
